notes.title: Just released - 10% launch discount available
notes.content:
Hello all,

The pixel indie game "Mostly Scared of Spiders" is now available on steam.

This adventure survival game is set in the Australian Outback.  On a journey with your party, your fate is determined by player skill and the choices you make.

The game offers multiple directions, based on both the fate of party members and player choice, each path with unique challenges.  The game offers multiple play throughs and multiple endings.

A survival mode is also available to test a players ability in a fast and frantic setting, challenging the player to beat their high score.

Please enjoy! ːsteamhappyː

Christopher Myerscough
HeroHead studios
